Verifier pseudocode (concise but complete):

```rust
fn admit(st: &mut GateState, rec_bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), Err> {
    let b = Frame::parse(rec_bytes)?;                    // E_CANON: exact length, magic, version, kind
    if b.seq != st.head_seq + 1            { return Err(E_SEQ); }
    if b.prev_root != st.root               { return Err(E_LINK); }
    let eh = Sha256::digest(b"OXLEDGER-ENTRY-v1" ++ b.bytes_upto_post_root_incl);
    if !ed25519_verify(&st.publisher_pk, &eh, b.sig) { return Err(E_SIG); }
    match b.kind {
        PUT => {}
        DEL => if !st.tree.contains(b.key) { return Err(E_DEL_ABSENT); }
    }
    let mut patch = st.tree.stage(b.key, b.value_or_tombstone);   // ≤32 node recomputes
    if compress(patch.root()) != b.post_root { return Err(E_ROOT); }
    st.tree.commit(patch);                                 // atomic
    append_fsync(rec_bytes);
    st.root = b.post_root; st.head_seq = b.seq;
    Ok(())
}
```
